summary: Reviewed all five changed files and the binding PRD sections. No definite defects identified by static review. Required execution checks and the failing-first run remain unverified because execution was prohibited.

checks.criterion: 1. Tests first, independent expanded-formula and Jones-vector oracles, and PRD arithmetic tolerances.
checks.evidence: Both independent oracles exist and contain no production-module imports: pipeline/tests/polarimetry/expanded_oracle.py:19 and jones_oracle.py:20. Fixture comparisons use rtol=1e-10 and atol=1e-12 at test_polarimetry_covariance.py:43 and :115. A historical failing run was not observed; execution was prohibited in the read-only sandbox.

checks.criterion: 2. Fixture construction asserts Hermitian PSD properties and the required F6/F7 eigenvalues before use.
checks.evidence: pipeline/tests/test_polarimetry_covariance.py:104 asserts Hermitian symmetry and PSD. F6 is constructed from (1, 0.2j, 0) and checked before return at :141–153. Both F7 eigenvalue sets are checked before return at :156–166.

checks.criterion: 3. F6 powers and F7 CPR ambiguity match the specified values.
checks.evidence: pipeline/tests/test_polarimetry_covariance.py:194–211 asserts OC=0.25, SC_LL=0.49 and SC_opp=0.09. Lines 256–273 assert identical channel powers, CPR values 3/19 and 1, and differing CPR. Numerical results were not executed because the sandbox is read-only.

checks.criterion: 4. Explicit unitary basis transformation and comparisons against both oracles on F6, F7 and 200 Hypothesis covariances.
checks.evidence: pipeline/src/terraluna_pipeline/polarimetry.py:957 defines the basis; :1176–1186 declares ordering and transmit vectors; :1302 applies U C U^H without expanded-formula computation. Tests at test_polarimetry_covariance.py:214, :233 and :923 compare both handednesses with both oracles. The numerical and randomized checks were not executed because execution was prohibited.

checks.criterion: 5. Required explicit convention, rejection of undeclared conventions, and handedness_verified=False by default.
checks.evidence: pipeline/src/terraluna_pipeline/polarimetry.py:1166 requires convention; :983–992 rejects unknown values. The output flag defaults to False at :1040 and conversion does not override it at :1335–1346. No equivalence label is emitted. Tests cover omitted/unknown conventions and the default flag at test_polarimetry_covariance.py:351, :371 and :397.

checks.criterion: 6. Invalid covariance causes, unpublished invalid values, no repair/clipping, and configurable arithmetic PSD tolerance.
checks.evidence: pipeline/src/terraluna_pipeline/polarimetry.py:1268–1298 classifies nonfinite, non-Hermitian, negative-diagonal and non-PSD inputs; :283–287 blanks invalid outputs to NaN. Tests at test_polarimetry_covariance.py:512–549 assert distinct causes and no published values; :608–622 checks negative eigenvalues without clipping; :697 checks input preservation. The tolerance argument is at polarimetry.py:1168, with the open real-data decision documented at :1202. Execution was prohibited.

checks.criterion: 7. Nonpositive OC/base_SC handling, handedness diagnostics, no epsilon, and no development threshold.
checks.evidence: pipeline/src/terraluna_pipeline/polarimetry.py:1308–1309 derives base_SC and the handedness term; :1319 and :1326–1332 apply explicit nonpositive-denominator reasons. Division at :1156 adds no epsilon, and no handedness threshold is applied. Tests at test_polarimetry_covariance.py:708–752 cover zero denominators, diagnostics and threshold absence. Numerical behavior was not executed because execution was prohibited.
